title: JET Pilot theme
description: A JET Pilot theme: a portable JSON theme file (version 1) plus an optional jetPilot block. Short form: name, appearance, canvas and accent.

version.description: 1 for the full form (optional in the canvas + accent short form).

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Derived from the name when missing.

appearance.description: The appearance of the base colours.

canvas.description: Seed: Main background behind content: tables, editor, terminal (--background). Seed of the derived palette.

accent.description: Seed: Brand / accent colour: links (--link), text selection (--selection), editor selection. Seed of the derived palette.

colors.description: The standard colour roles (any CSS colour). Missing roles are derived from the canvas and accent.

canvas.description: Main background behind content: tables, editor, terminal (--background). Seed of the derived palette.

chrome.description: Window chrome background in apps that have one. JET Pilot paints its chrome with `sidebar`.

toolbar.description: Toolbar background. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

toolbarForeground.description: Text on the toolbar. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

toolbarBorder.description: Toolbar border. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

toolbarControl.description: Toolbar button background. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

toolbarControlForeground.description: Toolbar button text. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

toolbarControlHover.description: Toolbar button background on hover. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

surface.description: Panels and cards: side panel, grouped settings (--surface-2 / --card).

surfaceRaised.description: Raised surfaces; the placeholder text is checked against it.

surfaceOverlay.description: Popovers, menus, dialogs, command palette and editor widgets (--surface-3 / --popover).

text.description: Primary text (--foreground). Derived at 7:1 on the canvas; a colour you set is kept unless it is below 4.5:1.

textMuted.description: Secondary text on the canvas; the editor's comments, punctuation and line numbers. JET Pilot's muted UI text is `mutedForeground`.

border.description: Hairline borders (--border); --border-subtle and --border-strong are mixed from it.

focus.description: Focus rings (--ring) and the editor's focus border. A neutral focus colour louder than 6:1 is softened toward the canvas for the rings.

accent.description: Brand / accent colour: links (--link), text selection (--selection), editor selection. Seed of the derived palette.

accentForeground.description: Text on a solid accent fill.

mutedForeground.description: Muted text: descriptions, captions, table meta (--muted-foreground).

secondaryLabel.description: Secondary labels. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

iconMuted.description: Muted icons. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

error.description: Error signal colour (solid fills); readable error text is `errorForeground`.

errorForeground.description: Readable error text; becomes --destructive (also checked on the canvas).

warning.description: Warning signal colour; editor find-match highlight.

warningForeground.description: Readable warning text; becomes --warning (also checked on the canvas).

update.description: Update notice colour. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

updateForeground.description: Text on update notices. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

updateSurface.description: Background of update notices. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

accentSurface.description: Hover and selected rows, menu highlight (--accent) and the editor's selected suggestion.

messageSurface.description: Message bubble background. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

messageForeground.description: Message bubble text. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

messageAction.description: Primary buttons, switches, the active nav indicator (--primary). When it is not a vivid colour (3:1 on the canvas, apart from accentSurface), the accent / focus colour is used instead. A neutral one louder than 6:1 (a monochrome theme's text colour) is softened toward the canvas, to at least 4.5:1.

messageActionHover.description: Primary button hover. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

sidebar.description: App chrome: navigation, tab bar, toolbars (--surface-1 / --sidebar).

sidebarControlSurface.description: Controls in the sidebar. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

sidebarRowHover.description: Sidebar row on hover. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

sidebarRowActive.description: Active sidebar row. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

sidebarRowSelected.description: Selected sidebar row. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

sidebarBorder.description: Sidebar border. Not painted by JET Pilot (kept for portable theme files).

terminalScrollbar.description: Scrollbar thumbs (--scrollbar), also in the editor.

variants.description: The other appearance (never the base one).

light.description: The other appearance. Either the structured form ({ "canvas", "accent", "colors", "jetPilot" }) or a flat role map.
